description: Review prayer_companion, novena_companion, and liturgical_calendar_app for improvements. Document design patterns and common structures for reuse in future apps.

title: Document design patterns and common structures
description: Created DESIGN_PATTERNS.md documenting architecture patterns across all Sancta Via Flutter apps. The document covers: 1) Architecture Overview - monorepo structure, feature-based directories, and dependency flow; 2) State Management Patterns - Riverpod FutureProvider, StateNotifierProvider, StateProvider, and derived providers; 3) Data Layer Patterns - Repository pattern with singleton, provider injection, and caching; 4) Navigation Patterns - GoRouter configuration; 5) Widget Patterns - ConsumerWidget, AsyncValue handling, accessibility; 6) Error Handling Patterns - AppLogger usage and repository error handling; 7) Testing Patterns - Mockito setup for repository testing; 8) Common Pitfalls to Avoid - StatelessWidget for logic, direct DB access, missing trailing commas, type inference; 9) Recommended Improvements - N+1 query fix, DateTime provider, accessibility audit, error logging. Also includes shared packages usage guide and liturgical theming reference.
